procedural_matters: N1.4(b) video provided by the OA. tracking provided by BRA observer AUS Jaime Swavley (coach) observer ricardo paranhos (coach)
facts: BRA and AUS on starboard-tack close-hauled
BRA was 1.5 lengths clear ahead and to leeward of AUS.
BRA was below the lay-line of the pin mark.
BRA tacked to port and crossed ahead of AUS, with a minimum distance of 1.5 meters with AUS.
After BRA’s tack, AUS luffed a short time and bear away immediately behind BRA.
No contact, no injury, no boat took a penalty.
conclusions: BRA on port kept clear of AUS starboard boat as required by RRS 10
